title: Market Observatory
subtitle: Indian equities, derivatives and flows — descriptive analysis, plus the step-5 replication of a published index; no signals or forecasts.

caveats.descriptive: Descriptive only — nothing here is a signal, forecast or backtest.
caveats.paper: PAPER ONLY, with no broker and no real money. ₹10,00,000 notional, bought at the 16 Oct 2026 open at the June 2026 review weights (whole shares, 0.1% per side cost, an estimate). The next rebalance is the Dec 2026 review. Benchmark: Nifty200 Momentum 30 Total Return Index (official, niftyindices.com); the price index is shown for context. Dividends are credited gross (pre-TDS) on the ex-date and splits/bonuses adjust share counts; rights and demergers are not adjusted.
caveats.mom30_gross: Replication results are gross of costs, like the TRI.
caveats.commodities: Commodities and FX are context only: they trade outside Indian hours, so cross-asset comparisons use weekly bars (scope §4.1).
caveats.fred_lag: FRED publishes with a lag, so as-of dates differ by series and are shown.
caveats.static: Static snapshot: numbers are as of the build time above, refreshed once a day; nothing on this page updates live.
